depiction_rules.notes: Use only in D029 stanza 7 as the stanza names Śakra. Keep him distinct from Narayana and Narada.

visual_bible.appearance: Mature, dignified deva leader with a clear individual face, modest ochre head ornament and warm cream garments with a muted maroon sash.
visual_bible.attribute: One lowered vajra may identify Indra; keep it separate from nearby bodies and never in contact with another figure.
visual_bible.body: One humanlike divine body with two attached arms, two hands and two legs; natural adult proportions.
visual_bible.style: Traditional matte mineral-pigment mural with dark contours and restrained ochre ornament.
